title: Rapid IR communications & logs protocol
content:
Purpose:
This note captures an operational protocol for on-call security teams to: (1) coordinate rapid communications during an incident; (2) prioritize evidence extraction from RBAC v2 and audit logs; (3) ensure SIEM export fields map cleanly to our post-incident artifacts; and (4) provide a concise postmortem skeleton.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to incidents with potential credential misuse, RBAC misconfiguration, or anomalous privilege escalation.
- Assumes RBAC v2 is active and audit-forwarding to the SIEM is configured with the current schema (see Audit Schema section).
- This is a living doc for on-call teams; keep it intentionally terse.

On-call roles and immediate actions (first 15 minutes):
1) Triage lead (SRE sec oncall) - declare incident severity and timeline. Post initial Slack incident channel: #sec-incident-<shortid>.
   - Template (first message):
     "INCIDENT: [sev] - short summary (e.g., RBAC role drift detected affecting prod). Triage lead: @name. Primary tasks: contain, collect evidence, escalate if required. Standup cadence: 10m."
